title: PG-19.2 memev work command wired to runWork with a production openStore (memev)
request: Version 2 of PG-19: it supersedes PG-19.1 (signed 1 Nov 2026; the PG-19.1 file is unchanged and stays on record, and the manifest and RECONCILIATION mark it superseded by this contract; owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026). Reason: PG-19.1 says that src/cli/work-store.mjs returns the real project store. SO-1.01 requirement 3 (checked by 'SO-1.01 req 3' in test/project-wiring.test.mjs) lets only the vault, the coordinator and the project store reach the store, so a store handed to the CLI would break that rule. In this version openStore in src/cli/work-store.mjs goes through one narrow read-only vault method, workImpactView, in src/engine/vault.mjs, which serves memev work impact and returns plain data: no ProjectStore instance and no write path. Every criterion of PG-19.1 is kept; the task title, the description and one requirement that said the CLI gets the real store are reworded; task WP19-03 is added for the facade, with scope additions src/engine/vault.mjs (that one method only) and docs/MODULES.md. The boundaries with SO-A-03 and SO-08-B below are kept as they were. The work is claimed and stacked on pull request #361, which adds the work case in src/cli/main.mjs that this contract reuses. Programme contract for work package WP19 in memev: wire the work command into the CLI and give runWork a production openStore. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. WP19 is a new gap found after the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 and decided under owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026; it is not in docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/. Depends on contracts: SO-A-03 (defines runWork and memev work status; signed fold contract, cited by id), SO-1.01 (the store, the state machine and the coordinator as one authority). Searched before drafting: no spec under contracts/*/specs names runWork or openStore, and none has a criterion for the work dispatch in src/cli/main.mjs; SO-A-01 lists main.mjs in its scope for memev work prefer only. Boundary with SO-08-B: it stays recovery and control under WP08-02; this contract adds no recovery or control command, only the dispatch, the port and the tests. Boundary with SO-A-03: src/cli/work.mjs and runWork belong to it; this contract changes neither. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.

tasks.title: memev work dispatches to runWork from main.mjs, with a production openStore port that reaches project state only through a read-only vault method
requirements: SR-1.15: no code without a caller (source: docs/scope-one/WBS.md leaf 2.2.15; owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)

SO-A-03 (signed fold contract, cited by id; pull request #341) defines runWork and memev work status in src/cli/work.mjs; this spec wires them into the CLI and does not restate them (source: pull request #341, owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)
SO-08-B (signed vault contract, cited by id) stays recovery and control under WP08-02; this spec adds no recovery or control command (source: owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)

SO-1.01 (canonical execution integration) keeps the store, the state machine and the coordinator as one authority, and requirement 3 lets only the vault, the coordinator and the project store reach the store; the port reaches project state only through the read-only vault method workImpactView (src/engine/vault.mjs), which returns plain data and no project store and adds no second path (source: contracts/scope-one/specs/SO-1.01-canonical-execution-integration.json; test/project-wiring.test.mjs)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. The gap: src/cli/main.mjs does not dispatch memev work impact, and runWork has no production way to read the project data it needs. The work case for status, pause, resume and cancel is added by pull request #361, which this task builds on and reuses; this task adds to that case the openStore port argument. It adds one port module, src/cli/work-store.mjs, that exports openStore: openStore calls the read-only vault method workImpactView (src/engine/vault.mjs), which returns plain data and no project store for the vault at the resolved root. It never returns, imports or names the project store or the coordinator, because SO-1.01 requirement 3 lets only the vault, the coordinator and the project store reach the store. No test double is used in a production path: a test injects its own view only through the same port argument that main.mjs fills with openStore. src/cli/work.mjs is owned by SO-A-03 and is not changed here; if runWork needs a port argument, that change is made in SO-A-03 first.

tasks.title: A narrow read-only vault method serves memev work impact: no ProjectStore instance and no write path leave the vault
requirements: SO-1.01 requirement 3 (test 'SO-1.01 req 3' in test/project-wiring.test.mjs): only the vault, the coordinator and the project store reach the store; a module of the CLI gets project data only from one vault method (source: contracts/scope-one/specs/SO-1.01-canonical-execution-integration.json; owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)
the vault method is read-only and returns plain data: it has no write methods, and no ProjectStore instance, directly or through a property or a prototype (source: owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)

SO-A-03 (signed fold contract, cited by id; pull request #341) and SO-08-B (signed vault contract, cited by id) keep their boundaries: this task adds one read method and no recovery or control command (source: owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. The vault is the only module that may hand project data to the CLI. This task adds one method to src/engine/vault.mjs, workImpactView(project, query), for memev work impact. It reads through the store the vault already owns and returns a frozen, plain data view (objects, arrays, strings and numbers): no ProjectStore instance, no function, no handle on the store and no write method. Only that one method is added to src/engine/vault.mjs; no other line of the file changes. The test builds a real vault and project with relationships, calls the method and checks the result. docs/MODULES.md is the generated module graph that a docs test checks.
